The base indices $i_x, i_y, i_z$ refer to the voxel closest to the query point in the negative direction.
The 64 samples are taken from indices $i_x-1$ to $i_x+2$ (and similarly for $y, z$).
**1D Cubic Kernel Evaluation:** For each axis, compute the interpolation weights using a cubic kernel $K(f)$.
The weight for a neighbor at offset $k$ (where $k \in \{-1, 0, 1, 2\}$) is $K(f - k)$.
They control the trade-off between smoothing and sharpening.
